title: A clearer path through the app garden
summary:
Nine clearer app filters, restored community apps, weekly Spore grants, and quieter work behind the Claude routes.

The app directory now has nine described filters, including Play, Learn, Build, and Business. The catalog also restored 18 missing community apps and added Inkverse, a tattoo-design app, and a D&D 3.5e magic-item generator.

Spore's grant changed to 1.5 Pollen per week, with a Monday 00:00 UTC refill; Microbe now has no grant and appears as “Account under review.” Enter and the tier API now distinguish weekly from daily grants, and the FAQ explains timing and non-rollover.

Five existing Claude routes moved to Anthropic's direct API without changing their public names. The MCP and OpenCode setup packages gained shorter names, and new OpenCode configurations default to `pollinations/claude-fast`. The README news section also recapped February 23's updates.

daily.title: Find apps by purpose
daily.text: Browse community apps with nine described filters, from Image and Chat to Play, Learn, and Build. Less guessing which shelf an app belongs on. [Explore the app showcase](https://pollinations.ai).
